must.why: About 15 balloons in a large bunch.
Balloons are multicoloured: blue, white, pink, yellow, polka dots.

must.item: Each balloon has own visible dangling string
must.why: Strings are bundled together into one gathered bunch.

must.item: Pale blue sky, square, no text
must.why: Pale blue sky, square frame, no text. This is a photo, not an illustration.

faults.what: Wrong balloon count: a large bunch of about 15 instead of three
Balloons are multicoloured and not red
Strings gathered into one bundle and a hand appears at the bottom edge

summary: A nice, realistic photo of a large bunch of multicoloured polka-dot balloons on a blue sky, but it misses the three-red-balloons spec: wrong count, wrong colour, and strings bundled together.
